title: DATA-SIDE FRONTIER MAP (0150 duality, data half) + S17 LAUNCHED: the missing-tail measured face is pinned in-tree as E1ClauseV3 on (G_LAST, T_MEAS] with G_LAST = 30001045999.981975555 = 3.0001e10, T_MEAS = 1000*G_LAST = 3.0001e13, U_TOP = 1e30; the 21-row face (17x s9: 10 straddles at G+k/2 + 7 logspread 1.05-2.2G; 4x s16: 10/50/100/1000G) fits the ln-t defect law M(t) = A ln t + B to max|resid| 6704.088 with the PINNED constants A = -25256007, B = +523513775 reproduced EXACTLY from the raw row files (audit re-verification: max at t = 2.2G, M sweeping -8.577e7 to -2.602e8); the machine zeta channel runs to 9e18 (0085: dps-40 fits at 9e18, OOMs fresh at 3e19; 0086: wall locked [9e18, 3e19) for ALL precisions, memory = N x term-cost, N = sqrt(t/2pi)) - so a 5.5-DECade gap (3.0001e13, 9e18] has NO measured rows. S17 (scripts/rh/s17_M_far2.py, launched this unit, pid 3877083, tmp/s17_run.log, ETA ~2.5-3.5h: ~85min streaming pass over the 1.016e11 certified tail (0, 3e10] at 12 targets + per-row dps-40 zeta + I_far split quad + f64 u-trap cross-check) measures 12 new rows on (3.16e13, 9e18] (half-decade spacing 3.16e13..3.16e18 + the 9e18 wall probe LAST so earlier rows flush first) and re-fits the three growth-family discriminators over the full G -> 9e18 span: F1 = A ln t + B (smooth), F2 = + C*(t ln t)/G (pole-at-G / constant-count offset), F3 = + C*(t/G)^2 (far-bias / kernel -t^2/g^2 tail). If F1 wins with a bounded residual over 8.5 decades, the E1ClauseV3 measured domain extends to 9e18 (the machine wall) and the ln-t shape of the missing tail is decisively pinned (the far-zero RVM model channel reproduces the true zeta to 6704-scale residual at heights 300x above the deepest measured zero); if F2/F3 wins, the extension term is identified and the defect law is corrected in the next unit. Known channel note recorded: at r=10G the independent f64 u-trap differs from the dps-40 quad I_far by 6.77e7 (trap = exploratory cross-check only; the dps-40 split quad is the certified channel, exactly as in s9/s16). The below-face data program is unchanged (E1Clause B=2 on the 505-row s8 face (3.23e9, 2.79e10); S1Marg 25 certified real-zero candidates margin >= 1 to 2.8e7, exploratory density-only dip from 3.1e7 = repair-list class, all below the face floor H >= 3.06e10). No in-tree formal change this unit (the extension lands as 0152 data + optional T_MEAS update once rows verify). No RH claim.
body:
## The data half of the last mile (verified from source + raw rows)

Constants (formal/RhAttack/E1Clause.lean): G_LAST = 30001045999.981975555, T_MEAS = 1000 * G_LAST, U_TOP = 10^30; defect_A = -25256007, defect_B = +523513775; E1ClauseV3 q B := (forall t, G_LAST < t <= T_MEAS, straddleRow q t -> |M_wp q t - M_defect t| <= B) with B = 6704.088 data-supported by 21 deduped measured rows.

Closure chain (s9/s16, all channels independently verified): M(t) = EPS + log|zeta(1/2+it)| - lm(t) - la(t) - re(t) - I_far(t), where la = the (0, 1e7] zero sum (GN), re = the (1e7, 3e10] vectorized stream over the five certified files (L 2.0e7-scale RAM + A (3.1946e7, 1.006e9] 2.792e9 + B (1.002e9, 2.002e9] 3.066e9 + C (2.002e9, 2.999e9] 3.143e9 + D (2.999e9, 3.0001e10] 9.258e10 = 1.016e11 certified tail), I_far = the RVM far-zero model over (G_LAST, 1e30] (dps-40 split tanh-sinh quad at the ln-t in-band singularity; f64 2M-point u-trap as exploratory cross-check). The far zeros (3e10, 1e30] are carried by the model channel - NO zero data beyond 3e10 is used or assumed.

Raw-row audit (this unit, re-derived from tmp/s9_dk_above_g.jsonl + tmp/s16_M_far.jsonl): 21 rows, M(t):
  t = G+k/2 (k=1..10):  -8.5772e7 (residuals +2624..2626)
  t = 1.05G..2.2G (7 logspread): -8.70e7..-1.057e8 (residuals +1411..-6704.088, max exactly at 2.2G)
  t = 10G: -1.4393461560e8 (-5792.878); 50G: -1.8458e8 (-2007.733); 100G: -2.0208e8 (-322.826); 1000G: -2.6023174558e8 (+5287.600)
  -> max |residual| = 6704.088, matching the pinned in-tree constant to the printed digit; the pinned A, B reproduce the face exactly. The ln-t slope is stable across the whole span: M(1000G) - M(G) = -1.7446e8 vs A*(ln 1000) = -1.7446e8 to 5 digits.

## The gap and the S17 run

The machine zeta wall (0085/0086, locked): dps-40 fits at 9e18, OOMs fresh at 3e19 for ALL precisions (memory = N x term-cost, N = sqrt(t/2pi), term-cost precision-independent 53-62 B). Between the deepest measured row (1000G = 3.0001e13) and the wall (9e18) there are 5.5 empty decades. S17 fills it: 12 rows at 10^13.5, 10^14, 10^14.5, ..., 10^18.5 (11 half-decade rows) + 9e18 (wall probe, last, crash-isolated by incremental jsonl flush). Runtime reference (s16 log): L 2s, A 40s, B 83s, C 133s, D 1425s at 4 targets -> ~12/4 scale ~ 85 min; per row 1-5 s + quad at low t (rising toward the wall). Total ETA 2.5-3.5 h.

## Decision rules (pre-registered, for 0152)
- F1 max|resid| over the full 33-row span stays O(1e4) (within the 21-row scale): the ln-t defect law is confirmed to 9e18 -> the E1ClauseV3 measured domain extends to the machine wall; the missing tail grows as -2.5256e7 ln t + 5.235e8 across 8.5 decades; the RVM far-zero model reproduces the true zeta channel-wise at heights 300x above the deepest measured zero.
- F2 or F3 reduces the max|resid| by an order of magnitude or more: the extension term is identified (pole-at-G or far-bias kernel) and the defect law is corrected with the new term in 0152.
- The 9e18 row OOMs: drop it (the wall is the wall, 0085 stands); the 3.16e18 row is the new frontier either way.

## Status of the rest of the data program (unchanged, for the ledger)
- E1Clause (B = 2 form): 505-row s8 face on (3.23e9, 2.79e10], |M_wp| <= 1.5555, margin 0.4445 - below-face territory (killed there by the allOnLineUpTo record input anyway).
- S1Marg (the hs1 uniformity track, P1.1e best-straddle margin |zeta| * min_d |R-1| / (B + |zeta - K|)): 25 certified REAL-zero candidate heights in [1e3, 2.8e7] with margin >= 1 (min certified 1.4138 at 19999999.8837), >= 13 below 1e6, >= 25 to 150000.2616; the 9 exploratory density-only rows (nominal decade points above 3e7) dip below 1 from 3.1e7 - repair-list class (the composite needs the exact discrete-tail treatment above 2.8e7 before it is a measurement, not a model evaluation). All well below the face floor H >= 3.06e10 (tPT) / 3.000175e12 (tPT2), so the S1Marg dip does not bite the terminal face - it is the low-band shadow, recorded for the G-hs1 ledger.
- I_far channel note: at r = 10G the f64 u-trap cross-check differs from the dps-40 split quad by 6.77e7 (|I_far| ~ 9e10 there, relative 7.5e-4); the quad is the certified channel (s9/s16 convention), the trap is the independent exploratory check. S17 records both per row.
